title: Até Aqui
summary: Kairos returns from the 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03 institutional break. Several players' updated nicknames quietly become current on internal systems with no ceremony: soupcrime becomes RAMENSOUP, velcrodog becomes velcroDAWG, parkinglot becomes p4rkingl0t (CS Academy), and Mako becomes SullCon, Grit becomes japalenogrits, Vex becomes vexemite (League Academies). Adrian gives all 25 players a full recap of 2026, confirms the CS Academy's current (not permanent) roles and TBD captaincy are unchanged, and the organization formally shifts from 'build' to 'compete,' with the February 8, 2027 debut window now 35 days away.
keyEvents: During the break, several players requested updated competitive nicknames; Emily Chen approved the changes internally, and the new nicknames appear on login screens and profiles with no announcement or ceremony.
soupcrime becomes RAMENSOUP (Evan's choice, referencing ramen as a childhood food, not sponsor-related).
velcrodog becomes velcroDAWG (Milo's restyling of the same nickname).
parkinglot becomes p4rkingl0t (Zayn's leet-speak restyling of the same nickname).
Mako becomes SullCon (Connor Sullivan's name condensed into one nickname).
Grit becomes japalenogrits (Lucas's nickname, referencing a bad personal memory involving jalapeño and grits).
Vex becomes vexemite (Benjamin's nickname, referencing trying and disliking Vegemite).
All 25 players attend a 09:30 auditorium briefing; Stewie2K jokes about CS Academy behaving during the break; velcroDAWG and p4rkingl0t deny any wrongdoing.

Adrian presents a full recap: Kairos's 2026 build-out (first LoL Main roster and mentors Darshan/Xmithie/Pobelter/Doublelift/Aphromoo, Academy Blue and Academy White rosters and coaches Hai and Sable, CS Main's roster and first external test (a private scrim loss to Team Liquid, 1-2, played on Dust2/Mirage/Nuke), CS Academy's roster and current roles, the Recreation Center, Dr. Maya Torres and Dr. Evelyn Park's sports/clinical psychology support, Arthur Fletcher's relocation to campus as family, the cancelled VALORANT expansion, long-term Dota 2 monitoring, and the New Balance uniform/apparel partnership).

The CURRENT ROLES board for CS Academy is reconfirmed unchanged: RAMENSOUP (IGL / Rifler), velcroDAWG (Entry Rifler), p4rkingl0t (Lurker / Rifler), dentalplan (Primary AWPer), wrongnumber (Anchor / Support Rifler); Captain remains TBD. velcroDAWG again suggests RAMENSOUP should be captain; RAMENSOUP declines the suggestion.

Adrian announces that 2027's competitive calendar includes League's expanded 2027 structure (First Stand, Crossroads Cup, MSI, Rift Masters, Worlds, Demacia Cup Global, and Tier 2 paths Crossroads Challengers, Rift Masters Challengers, WSCI), with zero qualifications, invites, titles, or official matches yet.

Adrian and Maya both frame 2027 as the year results, ranking, and difficult conversations about roster spots become real, and state that leadership means managing those conversations, not preventing them.
The February 8, 2027 debut window is now 35 days away; exact opponent and match remain TBD.
The campus planning board is updated from 'BUILD KAIROS' to 'COMPETE.'
consequences: RAMENSOUP, velcroDAWG, p4rkingl0t, SullCon, japalenogrits, and vexemite are the current nicknames for these six players from this episode forward; soupcrime, velcrodog, parkinglot, Mako, Grit, and Vex become former (historical) nicknames.
The CS Academy's current roles and TBD captaincy, set in episode-091, are reconfirmed unchanged going into 2027 competitive preparation.
canonIntroduced: The exact effective date of the six nickname changes is 2027-01-04.

Kairos's private scrim loss to Team Liquid (1-2) is recapped, played across Dust2 (Kairos loss), Mirage (Kairos win), and Nuke (Kairos win); this is a historical, non-official scrim and predates the Counter-Strike global map pool canon directive.
League's 2027 competitive structure (First Stand, Crossroads Cup, MSI, Rift Masters, Worlds, Demacia Cup Global; Tier 2 Crossroads Challengers, Rift Masters Challengers, WSCI) is named.
Kairos's VALORANT expansion was formally cancelled after being studied and planned; no roster, players, or staff were ever signed. Dota 2 remains under long-term monitoring only.
canonChanged: The campus-wide framing shifts from 'build' (2026) to 'compete' (2027).
continuityNotes: The nickname changes are personal/stylistic choices made during the break, not sponsor-driven, and are not retroactive: episodes before 2027-01-04 (including this episode's own recap of 2026) continue to use the historical nicknames where referring to events before this date.
The Team Liquid private scrim is historical and not an official match; it is not governed by the Counter-Strike global map pool ruleset introduced separately as canon.
realWorldReferences: Pobelter, Doublelift, Darshan, Xmithie, Hai, and Sable are referenced as real-world esports figures occupying fictional Kairos roles; no real-world biography beyond their confirmed Kairos roles is used.
